metadata.description: Electronic design automation plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: kicad-eda
plugins.description: Concept-to-Gerbers PCB design for KiCad 9/10: a headless gated pipeline (netlist -> ERC -> placement -> Freerouting -> DRC -> fab zip) with self-remediating reviews, plus a GUI-assisted flow. Bundled MCP server, autorouter, subagents, hooks.
